column1: # 10027 (Suspicious Comments) on our built JavaScript only: ZAP 2.17 finds JavaScript comments with the regex //.*
# so in a minified bundle (one long line) everything after any "//", such as in "https://", counts as a comment.
# The built bundle has no comments at all (Vite removes them). HTML pages are still checked by this rule.
